named_premises: State variable Φ lies in the compact interval [0, Φ_max].
Sign σ is conserved and takes values +1 or -1.
The scalar destiny equation dΦ/dt = σ γ Φ (Φ_max - Φ) determines the flow: for σ=+1, Φ monotonically increases toward Φ_max; for σ=-1, Φ monotonically decreases toward 0.
Φ_max is a positive bound (finite discretization uses Φ_max=4).
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Convergence of all soul trajectories to one of two fixed points under the scalar destiny equation

obstructions.reason: At the move from A0/P-IMAGO's general analogical order and compatibility with finality to the specific dynamical-system claim that every soul trajectory converges to a fixed-point attractor; no equation, state space, bounded Φ, or eschatological finality follows from A0+P-IMAGO alone.
